text:
Maya R: quick recap from today’s onboarding calls — hearing repeated asks about (1) per-route billing visibility, (2) faster embed refresh, and (3) an easy 'rollback' switch for model rollouts. jotting these here so we can prioritize.
Juan C: noted — we saw the same with Helio yesterday. small customers ask for exportable invoice breakdowns.
Juan C: also: several customers mentioned confusing default quotas in the console.
Priya S: good captures. can we map these to impact/effort? my proposal: high-impact/low-effort = per-route billing export; high-effort = rollback UI + backend.
Alex K: FYI telemetry shows 42% of onboarding flows hit the quotas page before first successful call. that supports the "confusing quotas" signal.
Sam P: +1 on a lightweight export first. i can sketch an export format (CSV + per-route token totals) and a sample support template for CS to send.
Maya R: thanks Sam. can you drop a mock and a sample support message by EOD? we’ll test on the next 3 customers.
Sam P: will do. planning to reuse the existing billing export backend; should be <2d dev.
onboard-bot: New onboarding session logged: session-2745 by Juan C — https://redwood.internal/onboard/session/2745
Priya S: for prioritization doc — can we add a quick checkbox for "renewal risk mitigated" so AMs can mark when an ask reduces churn risk?
Maya R: yes please. that would help downstream reporting to revops.
Alex K: one more data point — embedding refresh requests came mostly from teams using live content ingestion. maybe recommend a webhook-based push option vs polling initially.
Juan C: tagging customer examples: Helio Health, Brightlane, Nimbus.
Maya R: action items: (1) Sam mock export + support snippet (2) Priya to add "renewal risk" checkbox to the prioritization doc (3) Alex to outline webhook pattern for embed refresh (4) Maya to run 3-customer trial after we have the mock.
Priya S: I’ll create the doc here: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/CS/pages/CS-Feedback-Prioritization and share a template.
Juan C: :thumbsup:
Maya R: thanks all — short sync tomorrow 11am to review mock.
Alex K: 11am works for me.
Sam P: added to calendar.
Maya R: closing loop — please drop any raw quotes in the doc so product has context.
Juan C: will paste two short quotes from Helio later today.
